description: Send real test messages for a project to up to 50 explicit phone numbers. This delivers actual SMS or MMS to those recipients and incurs cost.

confirm.description: Must be true to run this write operation. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed.

merge_values.description: Optional merge-tag values, keyed by tag name, applied to every phone in this test send. When supplied, no contact is sampled from the project's lists; every tag renders from these values with the normal fallback chain (inline fallback, then org default, then standard default, then empty) for any tag not present here. Omit to sample from the lists as usual.

phones.description: Recipient phone numbers for the test send

name: test_project
